Copy or transfer ownership of mutable payloads\ndeliberately. `View` renders a snapshot without probing tools or mutating state.\n\n```text\ninput / timer → Update → model snapshot → View\n                  ↓\n             effect(service, context, request ID)\n                  ↓\n             result message → accept if still current\n```\n\nTrack a generation/request ID per independently refreshed view or query. Starting\na replacement read supersedes the previous generation. Include identity in every\nresult and reject stale success AND stale failure before changing visible state.\nCancel owned work when superseded or closed, but retain generation checks because\ncancellation races with completion. Closed dialogs must not reappear on a reply.\n\nWhen operations have dependencies, invalidate the dependent observation rather\nthan presenting it as current. Do not require every optional tab to finish\nbefore one view becomes usable. Model these outcomes distinctly:\n\n| Result | UI behavior |\n|---|---|\n| Loading with existing rows | Keep rows, show pending refresh |\n| Accepted fresh result | Replace snapshot; restore selection by ID |\n| Accepted successful empty result | Remove obsolete rows and show empty state |\n| Refresh error | Keep usable snapshot with error and its provenance |\n| Cached result | Label cached/stale; it is not completion of the live read |\n| Unknown observation | Preserve unknown; do not render as false/clean/healthy |\n\nTrack pending mutations by operation/target identity so repeated input does not\nstart conflicting writes. A completion updates the affected state and exposes\nthe result. Retry reads when appropriate; do not blindly retry writes with an\nunknown outcome. Reconcile state first. Load the active view first and optional\nviews on demand. Fresh local state can appear independently of remote state.\nAvoid expensive initialization before `Program.Run()` as well as inside Update.\n\nUse bounded concurrency and cancelable contexts for I/O. For log streams or large\ncollections, keep a bounded display buffer or virtualized viewport while keeping\nrequired durable data elsewhere. Coalesce superseded snapshots/progress updates;\ndo not drop business events or mutation receipts. Log follow mode is explicit;\nscrolling backward stops following until the user resumes it.\n\nChoose refresh cadence from workload and measure it. Do not make a fixed FPS cap\nthe definition of smoothness or add sleeps to hide a backlog. Report data size and terminal/multiplexer environment;\navoid claiming universal millisecond targets from one machine.\n\nDiagnostic tracing should be opt-in and bounded. A workflow factory mounts the same job/source forms in the dashboard or a standalone CLI. Playground is a persistent child model; Use transfers a schedule into an add draft. External editor, native SSH and third-party tool handoffs release terminal ownership.\n\nRaw source viewing is an owned, read-only snapshot model with independent scroll\nand search. Its edit event binds the viewed host/source, rather than a mutable\ndashboard selection. Whole-source editing uses a local 0600 draft and the shared\nPlanRawSource/Apply path. Syntax validation examines all proposed lines, including\nlines the job parser cannot understand; unchanged unsupported lines may be retained\nwith warnings. Repair reopens the same draft against the original revision. No raw\nedit automatically creates IDs, rewrites helper metadata or deletes script files.\n\n`internal/document` retains source bytes and changes selected entries. `internal/schedule` validates dialects and computes descriptions/future matches without starting a scheduler. `internal/service` implements snapshots, plans, writes, backups, scripts, execution and forecasts. `internal/transport` invokes native tools locally or through a quoted OpenSSH boundary. `internal/config` implements XDG/typed TOML; `internal/upgrade` owns executable upgrades only.\n\nWrite path: snapshot → plan/diff → review → revision check → private original-content backup → native install/regular-file replacement → read-back receipt. A client-side source lock coordinates cooperating processes, not external editors or other workstations. Human save/run summaries\ndo not replace machine receipts or collapse partial/unknown outcomes into success.\n\nStable job IDs live in versioned comments. Optional local helper sidecars bind to target/source/job and command digest; emitted cron/Pueue commands execute without them. Reads do not assign durable IDs. Ordinary comments remain comments; only the dedicated disabled-entry marker identifies managed disabled jobs.\n\nEffects return messages; the UI owns mutable state. Source reads use target/generation identities. Child completion and editor previews include model ownership, so old replies cannot close or update a new draft. Forms debounce/cancel discovery, preserve user edits when suggestions arrive, and cache previews outside View. Nested concept help has its own completion event. Dispatched writes are reconciled even when result/sidecar persistence fails; they are never blindly retried.\n\nSelection follows job identity; source scopes and Playground retain their context. Pure layouts supply rendering and visible mouse rectangles; hovered panes own wheel events and overlays consume input. Printable characters belong to fields. CLI Execute owns the OS signal context; Bubble Tea programs disable their competing signal handlers. Generated payloads are encoded once for native cron percent rules. Script discovery and preflight inspect bounded files/directories without executing user code. _**User (2026-09-24 10:49:34Z)**_

這是我跟Claude討論的內容
```
❯ create new terminal 時有 You have new mail. 這個是哪裡來的 怎麽實現的？

這是 shell 內建的功能，跟終端 app 無關。我先看一下你機器上的實際情況。

  Listed 1 directory

這則提示是 shell 的內建功能，跟終端 app 無關。

機制

zsh（bash 也一樣）啟動時和每隔 MAILCHECK 秒（你這裡是 60）會檢查一次信箱檔案。檢查的路徑取自 $MAIL 或 $MAILPATH。如果檔案的修改時間比上次檢查新，而且大小大於 0，就印出 You have new mail.。

你的 $MAIL 是空的，但 macOS 上 zsh 會退回預設的 /var/mail/$USER。所以每開一個新 terminal，shell 發現這個檔案有新內容，就會提示。

你的信是誰寄的

/var/mail/zhouhanru 已經有 225KB。內容是 cron daemon 寄來的。信裡的 Subject 是這類 cron 任務：

Cron <zhouhanru@Hanrus-Mac-mini> '/opt/homebrew/bin/pueue' 'add' ... 'lazycrontab:...' ... 'echo "hi"'

這來自你的 lazycrontab 專案。cron 任務只要有 stdout/stderr 輸出，或非零退出，cron 就把輸出用本機的 Postfix 投遞給你自己。這裡每分鐘一次，pueue add --print-task-id 印出 task id（信裡的 4），所以信箱一直在漲。

處理方式

- 看信：mail（輸入數字讀信，d * 刪全部，q 離開）。
- 清空：: > /var/mail/$USER。
- 不再收到 cron 信，有兩種做法：
  - 在 crontab -e 頂部加 MAILTO=""。
  - 在每條命令後面加 >/dev/null 2>&1。lazycrontab 生成 crontab 的地方可以順手加上。
- 只關掉提示、保留信件：在 ~/.zshrc 加 unset MAILCHECK，或 MAILPATH= 留空。

你要我幫你清空信箱，或是改 crontab 加 MAILTO="" 嗎？

✻ Brewed for 16s · done 4:47 PM

※ recap: 你在查新開 terminal 時出現 "You have new mail." 的來源；我已查明是 shell 檢查 /var/mail/zhouhanru，裡面是 lazycrontab 的 cron 任務每分鐘寄來的輸出。下一步是你決定要清空信箱還是在 crontab 加 MAILTO=""。 (disable recaps in /config)

❯ 所以這個mail 跟系統Mail app有關嗎？ 這是crontab的feature還是系統的feature; linux有嗎？ (e.g. /var/mail?)

跟 Mail.app 無關。 這是 Unix 本來就有的本機郵件機制，比 Mail.app 早很多年。Mail.app 是 IMAP/Exchange 用戶端，讀的是遠端信箱，不會碰 /var/mail。

這是三層東西疊在一起

┌────────────────┬───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│       層       │                                  誰負責                                   │                                 做什麼                                 │
├────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┼────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ 1. 產生信      │ cron（crontab feature）                                                   │ 任務有輸出就寄給任務擁有者，可用 MAILTO 改收件人或關掉                 │
├────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┼────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ 2. 投遞 / 儲存 │ MTA（macOS 是 Postfix，Linux 常見 Postfix / Exim / sendmail / OpenSMTPD） │ 收信後把它 append 到 /var/mail/<user>（mbox 格式，一封接一封的純文字） │
├────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┼────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ 3. 提示        │ shell（zsh/bash 的 MAILCHECK）                                            │ 發現信箱檔變新就印 You have new mail.                                  │
└────────────────┴───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┴────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

所以你看到的提示是第 3 層，信的來源是第 1 層，中間靠第 2 層。三者互相不依賴：任何程式只要把信交給本機 MTA 寄給你，都會出現同樣的提示，例如 at、periodic、系統的 daily 報告，或 echo hi | mail $USER。

Linux 有嗎？

有，機制一樣，只是預設行為不同：

- 路徑是 /var/mail/$USER（/var/spool/mail 是它的 symlink 或舊路徑）。
- 用 mail / mailx / mutt 讀信。
- cron 一樣會寄信，前提是機器上裝了 MTA。
- 很多 Linux 發行版，尤其是 Ubuntu/Debian 的最小安裝，預設沒裝 MTA，cron 的輸出就默默丟掉。
- bash 的提示文字一樣，也用 MAILCHECK、MAIL、MAILPATH。
- 兩邊差別只在預設值：macOS 預設 Postfix 可用，而且 cron 產生的信會被投遞。

補充

- macOS 上 Postfix 只在有本機投遞需求時才被喚起。這就是你沒設定過任何東西，信箱卻有 225KB 的原因。
- 這個機制是 1970 年代 Unix 的 mail 遺產。今天大多數人不用它，它就成了一個被遺忘的角落。

L18: The page documents crontab syntax and execution behavior:
L19: - Active lines contain either environment assignments or scheduled commands.
L20: - Blank lines and comment lines are ignored; inline comments are not supported.
L21: - Cron sets `SHELL=/bin/sh`, with `HOME` and `LOGNAME` derived from the owner’s account. The crontab may override `HOME` and `SHELL`, but not `LOGNAME`.
L22: - `MAILTO` controls delivery of job output; an empty value disables mail. ([man7.org](https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man5/crontab.5.html))
L23:

Unescaped `%` characters become newlines, and content after the first `%` is supplied as standard input. `CRON_TZ` specifies the table’s scheduling timezone. The manual notes that nonexistent daylight-saving times do not match, while repeated times can execute matching jobs twice. ([man7.org](https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man5/crontab.5.html))

_**Agent (gpt-6-astra 2026-09-24 11:02:31Z)**_

可以控制，設定就在 **crontab 本身**：

- 未設定 `MAILTO`：通常寄給該 crontab 的擁有者。
- `MAILTO="地址"`：指定收件人。
- `MAILTO=""`：停用該設定範圍內的 cron 郵件。

投遞仍依賴主機的郵件服務；`MAILTO` 不會替你設定 SMTP。它也不是一般的子程序環境變數，所以在 job 的 Variables 裡填 `MAILTO=""`，不能等同修改 cron 的寄信設定。現有的 **V / 編輯原始 crontab** 已可透過 review 修改它。[crontab 說明](https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man5/crontab.5.html)

這次我會把「每個 job 的輸出策略」和「crontab 的郵件設定」分清楚，並在 review 顯示輸出最後交給誰。順帶修正 Claude 的一點：cron 主要依據**有沒有輸出**寄信，單純非零退出不保證會收到信。[Apple cron 實作](https://github.com/apple-oss-distributions/cron/blob/main/cron/do_command.c)
